data.current_summary: Read the practice's profile and directory: contact details, locations and hours, providers, visit types and procedures, staff directory, policies, insurances, hospital affiliations.
data.current_description: Reads the profile of the practice the token belongs to — its name, callback phone, time zone (only when unambiguous across its listed locations), cancellation notice, financing and paperwork guidance, the locations shown for online scheduling with address, opening hours and contact points, staff directory, consultation policies, accepted insurance carriers with their plans, and hospital affiliations. Use it to answer the patient's questions about the practice itself ("where are you", "when are you open", "do you take my insurance", "what is your cancellation policy"). It also carries the directory with ids — the locations, the providers with the locations each practices at, and the visit types with the procedures the practice pairs with each for online scheduling — the same items the list endpoints return. None of it is filtered by the online-booking rules: for what the practice offers for online booking, use listSchedulingVisitTypes, listSchedulingLocations and listSchedulingProviders, and searchSlots for open times. Staff-authored text is plain text; empty lists mean the practice maintains nothing there.

data.current_summary: Search bookable slots for a visit type and procedure at a location within a date window.
data.current_description: Finds bookable times by the same rules as online scheduling. Pass the visit type + procedure pair from listSchedulingVisitTypes and a location where it is offered (each provider from listSchedulingProviders with the pair lists them), plus a from/to window of at most 14 days; add providerId for one provider, or omit it for every provider who takes the pair there. The scheduling lists do not check open times, so a valid query may return an empty page — the pair isn't offered at that location or nothing is open in that window: try the next window, another location or provider; for a longer horizon, run consecutive windows. Each slot names its provider, location, visit type and procedure, and its id is what you pass to getSlot and bookAppointment.
data.summary_suggestion: Search available appointment slots by visit type and location
data.description_suggestion: Searches for available appointment slots matching the specified visit type, procedure, and location within a date window (maximum 14 days). Required inputs: visitTypeId and procedureId (from listSchedulingVisitTypes), locationId, and a from/to date range. Optional: providerId to filter to a specific provider; omit to search all providers offering that visit type and procedure at the location. Returns a paginated list of slots, each with provider, location, visit type, procedure, and a slotId for use with getSlot or bookAppointment. Note: an empty result may indicate the visit type/procedure is not offered at that location, no availability exists in the window, or the provider is not available. For longer date ranges, execute consecutive 14-day searches.

data.current_summary: Read a single slot with live availability and the details to read back before booking.
data.current_description: The pre-booking read-back: one slot with display names and live availability — available is true only when the slot still passes the rules searchSlots applies (the same rules as online scheduling), and such a slot is re-checked in the practice's scheduling system inside this read, so expect seconds rather than milliseconds. When available is false the response carries only id/start/end — re-search instead of reading it back. visitType/procedure may be absent when the practice's mapping can't pin a single answer; you already know the pair you searched with, so read those back.
data.summary_suggestion: Verify slot availability and retrieve booking details
data.description_suggestion: Retrieves a single slot by slotId to verify current availability before booking. Returns the slot with display names, provider, location, visit type, and procedure details. The 'available' field indicates whether the slot still meets scheduling criteria (re-validated against the practice's live system, typically taking seconds). When available is true, the slot is ready to book via bookAppointment. When available is false, only id/start/end are returned; re-search for alternative slots. Note: visitType and procedure may be omitted if the practice's system cannot determine a single mapping; use the values from your original search.
